parameters.content:
## Practice setup required
On n8n Cloud, the instance owner/admin installs the verified AppStruct node from the canvas node panel. For self-hosted n8n, node 2.x requires n8n 2.47.7+ / Node.js 24+. Check the installed version; this exercise describes AppStruct 2.0.1. Select your own credential, practice project and small table. This workflow is inactive and has no destination.

Manual preview returns current rows. First successful automatic poll creates a baseline without change output. Add a fictional row only after that baseline, then inspect the next poll and an unchanged repeat.

Setup: https://appstruct.ai/integrations/n8n#n8n-cloud
Guide: https://blog.appstruct.ai/blog/n8n-polling-triggers-appstruct
The account credential is not read-only. Keep execution output private.
